name: sentaurus-web-agent
description: Browser dashboard/chat for a Sentaurus TCAD agent bridge.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @sentaurus-agent/server" "npm run dev -w @sentaurus-agent/web"
scripts.build: npm run prepare:shared && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run prepare:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
